name: Broad money (M2) — month-end
description: Broad money (M2), month-end stock, Rs billion, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin (Selected Economic Indicators). Monthly since 2007; our other M2 series are weekly or quarterly. Each point carries its first print and every revision.

name: KIBOR 1-month — month-end
description: 1-month KIBOR (offer) at month-end, percent, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin. Monthly since 2007.

name: KIBOR 1-month — monthly average
description: 1-month KIBOR (offer), average of the month's fixings, percent, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin. Monthly since 2007.

name: Scheduled banks' advances-to-deposits ratio (monthly)
description: Ratio of scheduled banks' advances to deposits, percent, month-end, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin. Monthly since 2004 (our other ADR series are quarterly).
labels: Ratio of Scheduled Banks' Advances to Deposits Percent

name: Scheduled banks' investment-to-deposits ratio (monthly)
description: Ratio of scheduled banks' investments to deposits, percent, month-end, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin. Monthly since 2004.
labels: Ratio of Scheduled Banks' Investment to Deposits "

name: Core inflation, 20% trimmed mean (national, YoY) — historical
description: National core inflation, 20% trimmed mean, year-on-year percent, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin, 2007-2019 (base 2007-08; superseded by the base-2015-16 urban/rural trimmed-mean series). Historical series.

name: CPI food inflation (national, YoY) — historical
description: National CPI food inflation, year-on-year percent, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin, 2007-2019 (base 2000-01 then 2007-08). Since 2016 PBS publishes food inflation for urban and rural areas separately. Historical series.

name: CPI non-food inflation (national, YoY) — historical
description: National CPI non-food inflation, year-on-year percent, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin, 2007-2019. Historical series.

name: Core inflation, non-food non-energy (national, YoY) — historical
description: National core inflation excluding food and energy (NFNE), year-on-year percent, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin, 2007-2019 (superseded by the base-2015-16 urban/rural NFNE series). Historical series.
labels: Core Inflation YoY (Non Food, Non Energy) "

name: Consumer Price Index, national (2007-08 = 100) — historical
description: National CPI level, base 2007-08 = 100, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin, 2010-2019 (PBS rebased to 2015-16 in 2019). Historical series.

name: Consumer Price Index, national (2000-01 = 100) — historical
description: National CPI level, base 2000-01 = 100, as printed in SBP's Monthly Statistical Bulletin, 2004-2011 (PBS rebased to 2007-08 in 2011). Historical series.
